 How to Watch Pistons vs Heat
 When: Friday, October 23, 2026
 Time: 8:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: The Spot – Detroit 20 (WMYD)
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Detroit enters Friday's matchup following an impressive 121-113 comeback victory over the Boston Celtics in Tuesday's season opener. Cade Cunningham led the Pistons with 22 points and eight assists, while Jalen Duren added 22 points and nine rebounds. Duncan Robinson contributed 21 points, connecting on five three-pointers, and Javonte Green scored 19 points off the bench. Detroit erased a 22-point second-half deficit with a 23-0 run, outscoring Boston 39-25 in the fourth quarter to secure its first victory of the season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Miami looks to rebound after suffering a 131-106 loss to the Minnesota Timberwolves in Wednesday's season opener. Giannis Antetokounmpo led the Heat with 35 points and six rebounds in his Miami debut, shooting 13-for-19 from the field, while Bam Adebayo contributed 15 points and seven rebounds. Davion Mitchell added 11 assists, but Miami struggled from beyond the arc, making just eight of its 33 three-point attempts. The Heat were outrebounded 52-34 and surrendered nine three-pointers to Anthony Edwards, who finished with 45 points as Minnesota pulled away in the second half.
